'''Inea Pargen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the daughter of [[Nuun Pargen]]. At a young age, she was wounded during an attack on her father's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Crescent (freighter)|''Crescent'']], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
